_comment: PySCF 2.14.0 RHF/RKS whose exchange matrix is the COSX expression of qm_cosx.h on curcuma's own grid (CURCUMA_QM_COSX_DUMP; points and weights of -qm.cosx_grid, sorted into blocks), AO values from mol.eval_gto, potential integrals from libcint int1e_grids, overlap fit proj = solve(S~, S) (as PySCF sgx fit_ovlp), K symmetrised; exact J; B3LYP = xc b3lyp5 on atom_grid (50, 194), prune None (= curcuma -qm.grid sg1); conv_tol 1e-12. Script: docs/QM_COSX.md (pyscf_cosx.py). curcuma ran with -qm.scf_threshold 1e-10 and default -qm.cosx_threshold 1e-11 (the screen moves energies by <= 1.5e-9 Eh). Claude Generated (Nov 2026).
